md_heading_hierarchy.label: Heading hierarchy
md_heading_hierarchy.message: A heading skips one or more levels.
md_heading_hierarchy.description: Flags a heading that skips a level.

md_code_fence_balance.label: Code fence balance
md_code_fence_balance.message: A fenced code block is not closed.
md_code_fence_balance.description: Flags a fenced code block that is never closed.

md_table_wellformed.label: Table structure
md_table_wellformed.message: A Markdown table is missing its separator row.
md_table_wellformed.description: Flags a Markdown table written without a separator row.

md_image_ref.label: Image reference
md_image_ref.message: An image reference has no usable URL.
md_image_ref.description: Flags an image reference with no usable URL.

md_mermaid_block.label: Mermaid diagram
md_mermaid_block.message: A Mermaid block is empty or has no recognized diagram type.
md_mermaid_block.description: Flags a Mermaid block that is empty or has no recognized diagram type.

link_unresolved.label: Unavailable internal link
link_unresolved.message: This internal document link is unavailable.
link_unresolved.description: Flags a missing, archived, or inaccessible target in this workspace.

link_unresolved_citation.label: Unresolved citation
link_unresolved_citation.message: This citation names no document of this workspace, so it is not registered as a reference.
link_unresolved_citation.description: Shows @cite markers whose address names no document of this workspace.

link_broken-slug.label: Stale wiki-link slug
link_broken-slug.message: The wiki link [[{{written_slug}}]] still works, but the target is now [[{{current_slug}}]].
link_broken-slug.description: Flags pinned links whose written slug no longer matches the target page.

kb_orphan_page.label: Orphan page
kb_orphan_page.description: Flags a page that no other page targets with an authored link.

kb_missing_backlink.label: Missing backlink
kb_missing_backlink.message: {{source_slug}} has an authored link to {{target_slug}}, but the target has no authored link back.
kb_missing_backlink.description: Flags an authored link whose target page has no authored link back.

kb_duplicate_concept.label: Duplicate concept
kb_duplicate_concept.message: This page may duplicate another concept.
kb_duplicate_concept.description: Flags a page that may cover the same concept as another.

kb_term_collision.label: Name collision
kb_term_collision.message: A title, alias, or slug resolves to more than one page.
kb_term_collision.description: Flags a title, alias, or slug that resolves to more than one page.

nav_fanout_exceeded.label: Folder fanout
nav_fanout_exceeded.message: This folder has more than 50 visible children; split it into clearer branches.
nav_fanout_exceeded.description: Flags a folder with more visible children than the fanout limit.

nav_missing_summary.label: Missing navigation summary
nav_missing_summary.message: Add a discriminative navigation summary for this folder.
nav_missing_summary.description: Flags a folder with no navigation summary to tell it apart from its siblings.

nav_unreachable.label: Unreachable content
nav_unreachable.message: This content is not reachable through a visible primary tree path.
nav_unreachable.description: Flags content with no visible path through the primary tree.

kb_hot_path_unmaterialized.label: Read together, not linked
kb_hot_path_unmaterialized.message: Add a link to the other page in either page's body.
kb_hot_path_unmaterialized.description: Flags two pages that AI conversations often read together but that do not link to each other.

kb_semantic_near_duplicate.label: Possible duplicate
kb_semantic_near_duplicate.message: {{target_title}} and {{related_title}} are semantically similar. Merge them or make the difference clear.
kb_semantic_near_duplicate.description: Flags two pages similar enough to need a merge-or-distinguish decision.

kb_misplaced_page.label: Possible misplaced page
kb_misplaced_page.message: This page differs substantially from neighboring pages in its folder.
kb_misplaced_page.description: Flags a page that differs substantially from the others in its folder.

kb_dependent_maybe_stale.label: Possibly stale dependency
kb_dependent_maybe_stale.message: This page links to or cites {{related_title}}, which changed. Review the affected passage.
kb_dependent_maybe_stale.description: Flags a page whose source changed, so a passage may now be out of date.

maintenance_nav_summary_suggestion.label: Navigation summary proposal
maintenance_nav_summary_suggestion.message: An external maintenance run proposed a folder navigation summary.
maintenance_nav_summary_suggestion.description: Records folder navigation summaries proposed by an external maintenance run.

maintenance_coverage_gap_verdict.label: Coverage gap assessment
maintenance_coverage_gap_verdict.message: An external maintenance run assessed this coverage gap.
maintenance_coverage_gap_verdict.description: Records coverage-gap assessments from an external maintenance run.

maintenance_page_meta_suggestion.label: Page metadata proposal
maintenance_page_meta_suggestion.message: An external maintenance run proposed page metadata changes.
maintenance_page_meta_suggestion.description: Records page metadata changes proposed by an external maintenance run.

maintenance_import_batch_classification.label: Import classification
maintenance_import_batch_classification.message: An external maintenance run proposed import classification metadata.
maintenance_import_batch_classification.description: Records import classifications proposed by an external maintenance run.

maintenance_stale_contradiction_verdict.label: Dependency contradiction assessment
maintenance_stale_contradiction_verdict.message: An external maintenance run assessed whether a dependency is contradictory.
maintenance_stale_contradiction_verdict.description: Records dependency-contradiction assessments from an external maintenance run.

maintenance_golden_query_candidates.label: Evaluation query candidates
maintenance_golden_query_candidates.message: An external maintenance run proposed search evaluation queries.
maintenance_golden_query_candidates.description: Records search evaluation queries proposed by an external maintenance run.

link_foreign.label: Cross-workspace reference
link_foreign.message: Use a full permanent link for a document in another workspace.
link_foreign.description: Flags a lookup-only resource address that cannot resolve in this workspace.

link_target-unpublished.label: Unpublished link target
link_target-unpublished.message: The linked document has no published version.
link_target-unpublished.description: Flags a published document linking to a target readers cannot yet open.

link_internal-noncanonical.label: Legacy internal link
link_internal-noncanonical.description: Flags resolvable legacy addresses that can safely become permanent links.

fixDialog.title: Record as fixed
fixDialog.body: This action changes the finding status only. It never modifies page content.
